# Context Handoff: MeetingAssistant hybrid rebuild (Phases 1-3 complete)
*Session date: 2026-06-10 — Generated by session-summary skill*

## What this project is

MeetingAssistant is a native macOS SwiftUI app that records system audio plus microphone,
transcribes locally with WhisperKit (on-device, audio never leaves the Mac), and saves
Markdown transcripts. We are rebuilding it as a hybrid per `REBUILD_PLAN.md`: a
React/TypeScript UI in a Tauri v2 shell, talking NDJSON over stdio to a headless Swift
sidecar that reuses the existing `MeetingAssistantCore` via a read-only SwiftPM path
dependency. All rebuild work lives under `rebuild/`; the native app at the repo root stays
untouched. macOS only.

## Hard constraints (do not violate)

- Do NOT modify, move, or break the native Swift app at the repo root (`swift build`,
  `swift test`, `./script/build_and_run.sh` must keep working). Nothing edits the root
  `Package.swift`, `Sources/`, or `script/`.
- All rebuild code stays under `rebuild/`.
- Frozen contracts live in `rebuild/CONTRACT.md` (sidecar protocol + on-disk
  `recording.json` format + UserDefaults keys). Extend, never break. The seam tests
  (`rebuild/scripts/seam_check.sh`) must stay green.
- The section 6 parity matrix in `REBUILD_PLAN.md` is the acceptance checklist.
- Work in phases and STOP for the user's review at each phase boundary.
- Project rule (root `AGENTS.md`): always ask clarifying questions before implementing.
- Working mode: the assistant authors all code; the user builds/tests on their Mac and
  reports back (the assistant's sandbox has no swift/cargo/codesign; it does have node, so
  `npx tsc --noEmit` in `rebuild/app` works there).
- Identities (frozen): app `com.devswift.MeetingAssistant.rebuild`, sidecar
  `com.devswift.MeetingAssistant.rebuild.sidecar`, ad-hoc co-signed with pinned identifiers
  and designated requirements via `rebuild/scripts/build_and_run.sh`.

## What we worked on this session

- **Fixed the blank Tauri webview** (carried over from last session): Tauri v2 only embeds
  `frontendDist` when the `custom-protocol` cargo feature is on; plain `cargo build` left
  the app trying to load the (absent) Vite dev server. Added the feature to
  `app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml` and `--features custom-protocol` to the build script. UI now
  renders; devtools auto-opens at launch (cosmetic, remove when spike UI is retired).
- **Phase 1 closed**: TCC attributes Microphone and Screen Recording to the app
  ("MeetingAssistant Rebuild"), not the sidecar, so the embedded bare-binary sidecar holds
  (no nested helper .app needed). Full results in `rebuild/PHASE1_REPORT.md`.
- **Phase 2 done**: contracts frozen in `rebuild/CONTRACT.md` with TypeScript mirror
  `rebuild/app/src/contract.ts`; seam regression suite added as an XCTest target in
  `rebuild/sidecar/Tests/SeamTests/` (spawns the real binary, speaks NDJSON), plus a golden
  `recording.json` fixture roundtripped through the core's own Codable types.
- **Phase 3 done**: the sidecar now implements the full frozen command surface by reusing
  the core headlessly (`MeetingRecorder`, `RecordingStore`, `ModelDownloadManager`,
  `MarkdownExporter`): real record lifecycle (pause/resume/mute, draft `recording.json`,
  on-device transcription on stop), `model.*`, `library.*`, `export.*`, `storage.*`.
  A 120 ms MainActor poller emits `status`/`levels`/`transcription.progress`/`model.status`
  events on change; commands dispatch concurrently so a transcribing stop never blocks
  stdin. All verified on the user's Mac: 10/10 seam tests green including the full capture
  e2e (164 s: record, mute, pause/resume, stop, transcribe with the real Whisper model,
  verify document + pause interval, library list, delete, restore root). Root `swift build`
  and all 29 native tests still pass.

## Key files & structure (all under `rebuild/`)

- `CONTRACT.md` — THE authoritative frozen contract: envelope rules, every command with
  request/response shapes, events, error codes, on-disk format, UserDefaults keys.
- `PHASE1_REPORT.md` — Phase 1 acceptance report.
- `sidecar/Sources/meetingcore-sidecar/` — `main.swift` (stdin loop, dispatches commands
  non-blocking), `Protocol.swift` (envelope decode; protocol 1, sidecar 0.2.0),
  `Sidecar.swift` (SidecarIO writer, JSONCoding helper, SidecarController with all
  handlers + state poller), `Info.plist` (embedded via linker `-sectcreate`; the
  "unhandled resource" build warning is cosmetic).
- `sidecar/Tests/SeamTests/` — `SeamTests.swift` (harness + protocol/library/capture
  tests), `Fixtures/recording.json` (golden fixture). Run via
  `./rebuild/scripts/seam_check.sh`.
- `app/src/` — `contract.ts` (full typed mirror), `sidecar.ts` (typed client + command
  builders for the whole surface), `App.tsx` (still the Phase 1 spike panel; Phase 4
  replaces it).
- `app/src-tauri/` — `main.rs` (spawns sidecar, forwards stdout lines as `sidecar-event`,
  `sidecar_send`/`sidecar_hello` commands, opens devtools), `Cargo.toml` (now has
  `custom-protocol` feature), `tauri.conf.json`, `capabilities/default.json`.
- `scripts/build_and_run.sh` (build + stage + co-sign + launch the signed .app),
  `scripts/seam_check.sh` (swift build + swift test in `sidecar/`).
- `README.md`, `AGENTS.md` — kept current with phase status; update them on any contract,
  identity, signing, build-flow, or phase change.

## Decisions & context worth knowing

- Phase 3 scope decisions (user-confirmed): sidecar-only headless core (the plan's "strip
  views from the core" was overridden by the root-untouched constraint; unused SwiftUI
  views just never get instantiated); full frozen surface in one phase; sidecar uses its
  OWN UserDefaults domain with identical default paths, so the default library
  (`~/Documents/MeetingAssistant Recordings`) and model folder are shared with the native
  app, while custom-location overrides migrate at retirement.
- Contract resolutions: recording references use `recordingId` (the plan's `id` collides
  with the envelope id); `record.start`'s Phase 1 `outputDir` param is now ignored (use
  `storage.setRecordingsRoot`); additive commands `library.document` (detail view needs the
  full document) and `storage.setRetention` (UI cannot write the sidecar's defaults domain
  directly); additive `model.status` event carries model/download state changes.
- `record.start` requires the Whisper model on disk; `record.stop` transcribes before
  responding (can take minutes; `transcription.progress` events stream meanwhile).
- The spike UI's "Record 3 seconds" now creates a real meeting in the real library and
  looks stuck during transcription — expected until Phase 4.
- Test environment: the user's terminal now has Microphone and Screen Recording TCC grants
  (needed for the capture seam test). The mic prompt trick: pipe a
  `permissions.request` line into the debug sidecar binary from the terminal.
- Seam tests redirect the sidecar's recordings root to a temp dir and restore the default
  afterwards, so they never touch the real library.
- TypeScript typechecks clean (`npx tsc --noEmit` in `rebuild/app`).
